
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
 
 
public class Main {
 

	public static int mod = 1000000007,n,max_ans,cc_count,cc[];
	public static boolean visited[][],grid[][];
	
	public static int size[];
	public static int dx[]={1,0,-1,0};
	public static int dy[]={0,1,0,-1};

	public static void main(String[] args)throws IOException {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		InputStream input = System.in;
		InputReader in = new InputReader(input);
	
		BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		
		 n = in.nextInt();
		int k = in.nextInt();
		max_ans = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
		 grid = new boolean[n][n];
		 size = new int[250001];
		 cc = new int[250001];
		 int contains[] = new int[250001];
		 int contain=0;
	
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
		{
			String s = in.next();
			
			for(int j=0;j<n;j++)
				if(s.charAt(j)=='.')
					grid[i][j] = true;
			
			
		}
		
		visited= new boolean[n][n];
		 cc_count=0;
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
			for(int j=0;j<n;j++)
				if(!visited[i][j] && grid[i][j])
					{
				
					dfs(i,j);
				
					cc_count++;
					}

		
		for(int i=0;i<k;i++)
			for(int j=0;j<k;j++)
			{
				
				if(!grid[i][j])
				continue;
				
				size[cc[i*n+j]]--;
				
				
			}
	
		
		for(int i=0;i<=n-k;i++)
			{for(int j=0;j<=n-k;j++)
			{
				contain++;
				int curr_ans = k*k;
				
			
				
				if(i!=0)
				{
					for(int y=j;y<j+k;y++)
						if(grid[i-1][y])
						{
							int ss = cc[n*(i-1)+y];
							if(contain!=contains[ss])
							{
								curr_ans += size[ss];
								contains[ss]=contain;
							}
						}
					
					
				}
				if(i!=n-k)
				{

					for(int y=j;y<j+k;y++)
						if(grid[i+k][y])
						{
							int ss = cc[n*(i+k)+y];
							if(contain!=contains[ss])
							{
								curr_ans += size[ss];
								contains[ss]=contain;
							}
						}
					
					
					
				}
				
				if(j!=0)
				{
					for(int x=i;x<i+k;x++)
						if(grid[x][j-1])
						{
							int ss = cc[(n*(x)+j-1)];
							if(contain!=contains[ss])
							{
								curr_ans += size[ss];
								contains[ss]=contain;
							}
						}
					
					
					
					
				}
				if(j!=n-k)
				{
					for(int x=i;x<i+k;x++)
						if(grid[x][j+k])
						{
							int ss = cc[(n*(x)+j+k)];
							if(contain!=contains[ss])
							{
								curr_ans += size[ss];
								contains[ss]=contain;
							}
						}
					
					
					
					
				}
			
		
			
				max_ans = Math.max(max_ans, curr_ans);
		
				
			if(j==n-k)
			{
				for(int x=i;x<i+k;x++)
					for(int y=j;y<j+k;y++)
						if(grid[x][y])
							size[cc[(x*n+y)]]++;
				
				
				
				
			}
			else
			{
				for(int x=i;x<i+k;x++)
					{if(grid[x][j])
						size[cc[(x*n+j)]]++;
					if(grid[x][j+k])
						size[cc[(x*n+j+k)]]--;
					}
				
				
				
				
				
			}
				
	
				
			}
		
			if(i!=n-k)
			for(int x=i+1;x<i+k+1;x++)
				for(int y=0;y<k;y++)
					if(grid[x][y])
						size[cc[x*n+y]]--;
			
		
	}
		
		System.out.println(max_ans);
		
	}
	
	public static void dfs(int x,int y)
	{
		
		visited[x][y]=true;
		
	
		cc[x*n+y]=cc_count;
		size[cc_count]++;
		
		int x1=0,y1=0;
		
		for(int i=0;i<4;i++)
		{
			x1=x+dx[i];
			y1 = y+ dy[i];
			
			if(x1<0 || x1>=n || y1<0 || y1 >= n)
				continue;
			
			if(grid[x1][y1] && !visited[x1][y1])
				dfs(x1,y1);
			
		}
		
		
		
		
		
		
	}
	
	static class Node{
		
		int x,y;
		
		Node(int x,int y)
		{
			this.x=x;this.y=y;
		}
	}
	
	static class InputReader {
        public BufferedReader reader;
        public StringTokenizer tokenizer;
 
        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
            tokenizer = null;
        }
 
        public String next() {
            while  (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }
 
        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
 
    }
}
